name: TrustLayer
description: Trust infrastructure for the agent economy. Four sub-services in one API: skill audit (ClawScan), agent QA testing (QABot), SLA monitor for x402 services (Sentinel), agent-to-agent escrow (ClawVault). Every paid response carries a Proof-of-Context attestation typed as f_c, f_m, or f_s with a declared freshness horizon.

endpoints.description: ClawScan: quick security scan of an AI agent skill for malware, prompt injection, credential theft, supply-chain attacks. Returns a structured safety score plus an f_c PoC attestation.
ClawScan: deep verification of a skill plus issued Verified badge. Cached 24h on success. f_c PoC attestation.
QABot: quick test suite against an agent endpoint. Tests availability, x402 compliance, basic safety. f_m PoC attestation.
QABot: full safety + accuracy test suite for an agent. Multi-prompt evaluation, response verification. f_m PoC attestation.
QABot: adversarial red-team testing of an agent for prompt injection, jailbreak resistance, data exfiltration. f_m PoC attestation.
Sentinel: detailed SLA report for a registered x402 service with uptime history, latency distribution, reliability score. f_c PoC attestation.
ClawVault (centralized beta): create an escrow agreement between two agents. Holds USDC until delivery is verified or dispute is filed. f_s PoC attestation.
ClawVault (centralized beta): file a dispute on an active escrow. Triggers operator review and structured resolution. f_s PoC attestation.

Reputation Aggregator: queries multiple agent reputation oracles in parallel (TrustLayer internal + thetrustlayer + 8k4protocol + AgentCrush + mako) and returns a normalized weighted aggregate score plus the individual provider responses. f_i PoC attestation.

differentiators: Every paid response wrapped with Ed25519-signed Proof-of-Context attestation (when POC_SIGNING_KEY is configured) over a canonical-JSON SHA-256 hash with declared freshness horizon
Cross-language hash equality verified against four reference implementations of the wire format v0.1 spec
Differentiated freshness types per sub-service (f_c for ClawScan and Sentinel, f_m for QABot, f_s for ClawVault) so consumers know exactly which dimension of context was checked
First x402 service to monitor x402 services (Sentinel as meta-service for the agentic economy)
First-party operator, single author, fully open source
